title: AtomSD: Procedural Atom-Guided Self-Distillation for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.26926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) possess broad factual knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but solving complex tasks also requires procedural knowledge about how to act. Existing approaches often represent procedural knowledge through trajectories or bundled skills, limiting flexible reuse across interaction histories. This paper introduces Procedural Atoms, fine-grained and independently applicable units that represent Intent, When, Do, and Avoid guidance. Building on this representation, we propose AtomSD, an Atom-guided Self-Distillation framework in which the learner continually extracts Procedural Atoms from its own successful trajectories and distills them into the evolving policy through Atom-conditioned supervision and task-reward optimization. translated_title: AtomSD：面向大语言模型智能体的过程性原子引导自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）拥有广泛的事实知识和强大的推理能力，但解决复杂任务还需要关于“如何行动”的过程性知识。现有方法通常通过轨迹或捆绑技能来表示过程性知识，这限制了其在交互历史中的灵活复用。本文提出了“过程性原子”，这是一种细粒度且可独立应用的单元，用于表示意图、时机、执行和避免的指导信息。基于这一表示，我们提出了AtomSD——一种原子引导的自蒸馏框架，其中学习器持续地从自身的成功轨迹中提取过程性原子，并通过原子条件监督和任务奖励优化将其蒸馏到不断演进的策略中。全面的实验表明，AtomSD持续优于强力的基于奖励的方法和蒸馏方法，平均性能超出最先进的基线高达9.31分。
tldr: 提出AtomSD框架，将细粒度、可独立复用的“过程性原子”行动知识从智能体自身成功轨迹中持续提取并自蒸馏进策略，使LLM智能体性能超越现有最先进方法最多9.31分。
en_tdlr: AtomSD is an atom-guided self-distillation framework that continuously extracts fine-grained, independently applicable Procedural Atoms (Intent, When, Do, Avoid) from an LLM agent's own successful trajectories and distills them into the evolving policy, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by up to 9.31 points.
